description_en: Queries the specifications of computing resources for AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region
description_zh: 调用DescribeComputeResource接口查询数仓版集群指定地域下的计算资源规格
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-compute-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-version 3.0 --zone-id cn-beijing-f --db-cluster-id am-bp1r053byu48p0000 --migrate false --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeComputeResource

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The version of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster. Set the value to 3.0
parameters.name: db_cluster_version

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the most recent zone list
parameters.help_zh:
可用区ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the specifications of the available computing resources that are migrated from AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition to Data Lakehouse Edition. Valid values:

true
false (default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版迁移至AnalyticDB MySQL湖仓版的可用计算资源。取值：
true
false（默认值）
parameters.name: migrate

ComputeResource.description_en: The queried specifications of computing resources

DisplayValue.description_en: The specifications of computing resources displayed in the console
DisplayValue.description_zh: 控制台显示的计算资源规格

RealValue.description_en: The actual specifications of computing resources
